title: The W5' press-swallow over-swallows: the rail's full-height rect kills the last two tray chips (router_mid/router_high), which still PAINT OVER the plate while D is on
detail: While D is on, the two rightmost tray chips are visible (drawn over the plate's 'empty bottom' per the r1 W1 anchor regime) but their clicks are swallowed by the new plate-owns-presses check before the tray hit-test runs — router_mid is dead except an 8px sliver, router_high fully dead (chip 3 joins them at UI x1.5). The fix comment's premise ('tray ... inside the playfield') is false: the tray is win_w-centered.
recommended_fix: Exclude the tray band from the press swallow (e.g. only swallow when pos.y is above the tray top, or hit-test tray chips before the rail check in effect_ui_press), keeping the full rect for the wheel.

title: N7' residual: the r3 diff fixed the top-of-file 'Open Sans' occurrence but the exact occurrence N7' flagged (draw_noc_panel doc comment) still says 'Open Sans digits' — the panel draws with v.font_mono (Plex Mono)
detail: The claimed N7' fix landed on the wrong occurrence: the flagged draw_noc_panel comment still attributes the tabular digits to Open Sans while every draw in the panel uses v.font_mono (Plex Mono). Stale documentation in the exact spot the prior round named.
recommended_fix: Change 'Open Sans digits' to 'Plex Mono digits' in draw_noc_panel's doc comment (noc_overlay.odin:617).

title: noc_row_right is dead code the diff actively maintains — zero call sites repo-wide; the right-alignment need is served by noc_col
detail: The function was already uncalled at the base and this diff edited its body (NOC_PANEL_X -> noc_panel_x) to keep dead code compiling. No test pins it; the draw never calls it.
recommended_fix: Delete noc_row_right (or call it); keeping an edited-but-unreferenced helper invites divergence from noc_col's right-alignment discipline.
